milestones.name: F3D G0 — Baseline and authority
milestones.description: Current source/runtime/evidence crosswalk, preserved modes and saves, accepted authority/decision register, bounded fleet execution and source inventory.

milestones.name: F3D G1 — Series research and content contracts
milestones.description: Pinned era/faction/entity/terrain census, source confidence, mechanics reference cases and rights/distribution route per family; complete content schema and production fan-out.

milestones.name: F3D G2 — Real 3D feasibility
milestones.description: Read-only presentation seam and comparable measured renderer spike on named desktop/mobile devices; geometry, camera, picking, animation, fog and loading proven.

milestones.name: F3D G3 — World and gameplay systems
milestones.description: Authoritative elevation/surfaces, bridge collapse/repair/rebuild, navigation and required capabilities; deterministic state/replay/version contracts.

milestones.name: F3D G4 — Playable representative battle
milestones.description: Opposing clients complete base/economy/combat/transport/bridge destruction and rebuild with accepted 3D presentation, game feel and persistence.

milestones.name: F3D G5 — Complete era and faction production
milestones.description: Each required era's accepted census fully implemented with faction tech trees, all entity/model/animation/state work orders and independent acceptance.

milestones.name: F3D G6 — Whole-catalogue experience
milestones.description: All required terrain and content reconciled; cross-era balance, AI, mobile controls, audio, readability and visual quality accepted.

milestones.name: F3D G7 — Integrated qualification
milestones.description: Exact candidate passes multiplayer, save migration, crash/catchup, privacy, performance and independent regression evidence; original modes retain their own honest acceptance.

milestones.name: F3D G8 — Rollout and handover
milestones.description: Deploy qualified artifacts under existing authorization; verify actual served revisions, new/resumed player journeys, data conservation, monitoring and safe rollback.
